data.name: Simple Reanimation
data.description: You add Lesser Animate Dead to your formula book as a 3rd-level extract.  When you use this extract, rather than drinking it, you inject it into the corpse you intend to animate, which rises as an undead creature under your control 1 hour later.  This extract can only create zombies (including variant zombies).
